scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,admin -c green,yellow "npm run dev -w @royal-flush/web" "npm run dev -w @royal-flush/admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @royal-flush/contracts && npm run build -w @royal-flush/web && npm run build -w @royal-flush/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @royal-flush/contracts && npm run typecheck -w @royal-flush/web && npm run typecheck -w @royal-flush/admin
scripts.test: npm run test -w @royal-flush/web && npm run test -w @royal-flush/admin
